quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It tells drivers what they must do. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down when you see it. Trains cannot move out of your way, so you must wait for them to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming up.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you:

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should be ready to stop.
Must always stop at the railroad crossing ahead.
Must stop and wait for a signal before crossing the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a railroad crossing is ahead. Look and listen carefully. Slow down and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on vehicles that travel slowly.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to go the wrong way on a one-way street.
Do not drive in this lane.
Cars turning left on green must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cars turning left on green must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic light. It tells drivers that when turning left on a green light, you must let oncoming traffic pass first. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to upcoming road hazards. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road will curve ahead.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Keep going at your normal speed.
Look and listen. Be ready to stop if necessary.
Stop at the tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look and listen. Be ready to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, you must look and listen carefully. Slow down and be ready to stop. Let any trains pass before you continue.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and stop only if other cars are coming.
Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
Continue through the intersection, but be careful.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection. Only proceed when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does a posted speed limit sign show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed when conditions are good.
The maximum safe speed in all weather and road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed when conditions are good.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road when conditions are ideal. You may need to drive slower when weather is bad or roads are wet. Always adjust your speed to match the conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery and dangerous. This sign warns you that conditions are unsafe. Slow down on wet pavement because it takes longer to stop your car.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs show you are near a school zone or school crossing. Watch for children and follow the speed limit in school zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is coming from both directions ahead.

questions.question: What type of situation does this sign warn about?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turns permitted on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. It is illegal to turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is changing direction or getting narrower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is changing direction or getting narrower.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a change in road direction or a narrowing road. You may see several of these signs on sharp curves or at narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns of a railroad crossing coming up.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: Watch for cars merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for cars merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic may enter from a side road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs warn drivers to slow down at intersections. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you that roadwork is coming up. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns drivers about a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a school crossing is coming up.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers that:

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to conditions immediately ahead. This sign warns that the road has fewer lanes ahead and traffic must move left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to road conditions. This sign means the road will make a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if traffic conditions require it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a side road intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What should you do at a yield sign?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A yellow triangle with black letters means no passing zone. You will see this sign on two-lane roads where you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn you of upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that an intersection is coming so you can prepare to stop or turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the road.

questions.explanation: Yellow diamond-shaped warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. This sign means pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that another road will join from the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep or long hill is coming. The road may also have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and check for traffic before going. You can drive when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending soon.
The left lane is ending soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane will end soon.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs give?
questions.explanation: Blue signs give information about services for drivers, such as rest areas, food, gas, or hospitals.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of work zones. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead. Follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down over a traffic lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does an orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle mean?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles display an orange and red triangle on the back. Examples include farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and animal-drawn carts.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill grade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What is this bicyclist signaling?
questions.explanation: Bicyclists use hand and arm signals because they don't have turn signals. When a bicyclist holds their left arm straight out, they are signaling a left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you to drive carefully because wet roads can be slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to hazards. This sign warns that an upcoming bridge may be too narrow to pass a truck safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. This sign warns that you are about to enter a divided highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign indicates a crosswalk is ahead. Be alert and let pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what must you do?

options.text: You may pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road ahead.
You may pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings. You must obey all regulatory signs. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. When you see a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop. Do not go until it is safe to pass through the intersection.

questions.question: This sign warns of what?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead. Get ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions right ahead. This sign tells you to get ready for traffic to merge from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Get ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic will merge from the right. Be prepared to let that traffic merge safely.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what should you do?

options.text: You may continue straight or exit from this lane.
You may stay in this lane and continue straight.
You must exit if you stay in this lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit if you stay in this lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign on a yellow panel means this lane ends and becomes an exit ramp. If you stay in this lane, you must exit. You can also change lanes to continue on the highway.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:
questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign means you must follow the rule shown. This sign means do not pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: What does this sign warn about?

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane on a multi-lane road is ending. Drivers in that lane must move to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to places where animals, people, and bicycles may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway ends ahead.

questions.question: If you see a flashing red traffic light, you should:

options.text: You are traveling in the wrong direction.
Treat it like a stop sign. Come to a complete stop, then proceed carefully.
Keep going until the light turns green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign. Come to a complete stop, then proceed carefully.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Come to a complete stop at the stop line or before the crosswalk. Yield to all other traffic and pedestrians before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns that the divided highway ends ahead. Get ready to change lanes or adjust your position.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming ahead.

questions.question: This sign shows a type of:
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street in the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street in the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road or entrance. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Do not enter.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you which direction you must drive. You must follow the arrow's direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way paths. Stay to the right.

questions.question: This sign warns you are approaching:
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look and listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Come to a complete stop and look for pedestrians and traffic.
Slow down but do not stop completely.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and look for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and look for pedestrians and traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is always a stop sign. You must stop completely, look for pedestrians and other vehicles, and wait until the intersection is clear before going forward.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the start of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the start of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black symbols. They alert drivers to conditions ahead. This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it rains.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road meets a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road meets a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road intersects with a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate roads going in opposite directions, separated by a median or guard rail.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: When you approach an octagonal sign, you must:
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop, yield to traffic and pedestrians, and go forward when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black symbols. This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it rains.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, it means:

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead makes a very sharp turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead makes a very sharp turn.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black symbols and alert drivers to conditions ahead. This sign warns you to slow down because the road makes an abrupt sharp turn.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming conditions. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and be ready to adjust your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions. This sign alerts you that traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to make room.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the curve.
Slow to 35 mph or less before the curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow to 35 mph or less before the curve.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They show you what is ahead. Speed plaques tell you the safe speed for that area.

questions.question: From the center lane, what can you do?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns from either direction. Do not use it for passing or to drive straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic comes from both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter from your direction. Turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to bicycles crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always keep your speed the same.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic in.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic in.
questions.explanation: When you can, move to another lane to make room for entering traffic. This helps traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. There is an island, median, or barrier ahead. Stay to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a traffic rule. Where you see this sign, U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming. Slow down to drive safely through it.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and vehicles with a driver and at least one passenger.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces that are reserved only for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is a traffic rule that you must follow. Where this sign is posted, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead is now divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must let pedestrians cross first. Pay attention when driving through intersections or turning, especially where children cross.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road curves right first, then left. Slow down to safely handle the curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road is no longer divided. You are now on a two-way highway where traffic flows in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn about hazards ahead. Round signs are used only to warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the bridge or overpass ahead is low. Do not drive through if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road. Give them extra space to merge safely.
Traffic is entering from another road. Keep to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road. Give them extra space to merge safely.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will merge into your lane. Check your side and rear mirrors, then move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers a safe path.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive carefully and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must stop completely and wait for all vehicles and pedestrians to pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabilities. Only vehicles with a disability license plate or disability parking placard can park here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white sign means you must give the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow background. This sign warns that a traffic light is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road hazards ahead. This sign warns of an upcoming traffic light. Be ready to stop for a red light or move for other traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may go if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are driving the wrong way. You could crash head-on with other cars. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Do not drink if you plan to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic light, red is always on top and green on bottom. On a horizontal light, red is always on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests and use paddles and red flags to direct traffic through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means something is not allowed. This sign tells you that U-turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black letters or symbols. They warn drivers about hazards or special situations ahead.

questions.question: What should you do at this red and white sign?

options.text: Stop and look both ways before going.
Let other traffic pass before you go.
Keep the same speed and check all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let other traffic pass before you go.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Let any vehicles, bicycles, or pedestrians pass before you proceed. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a low ground railroad crossing. The tracks cross the road at a steep slope. Low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians who may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must turn either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell you the traffic rules you must follow. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive through the intersection at 55 mph.
The highest speed allowed is 55 mph in normal conditions.
You must not drive slower than 55 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest speed allowed is 55 mph in normal conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum speed limit for that road. You can drive slower if needed, but you cannot drive faster than the posted limit.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a divided highway is starting. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means you cannot do that action. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic only moves in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that people may be crossing the street. Be alert.

questions.question: When you see a stop sign, what should you do?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction you plan to go, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop. Look in all directions for traffic before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn of hazards. Orange signs are used in construction or maintenance areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
